alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 26 at 11:43AM PST until November 26 at 1:00PM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...The Dense Fog Advisory for today has been extended until 1
PM as many locations remain at or below one quarter mile of
visibility or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Caruthers - San Joaquin - Selma, Delano-Wasco-Shafter,
Fresno-Clovis, Hanford - Corcoran - Lemoore, Merced - Madera -
Mendota, Planada - Le Grand - Snelling, and Visalia - Porterville -
Reedley.

* WHEN...For the first Dense Fog Advisory, until 1 PM PST this
afternoon. For the second Dense Fog Advisory, from 8 PM this
evening to noon PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Visibility a quarter mile or less will make driving
conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highways affected include, but are not limited
to, Interstate 5, and Highways 99, 198, 180, 41, 43, 46, 140, 152,
58, and 33.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your low beam headlights, and leave plenty
of distance ahead of you.
